title: Product Builder, AI Insights
location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description: Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us! Figma’s AI Insights team, within Research, is hiring a builder with exceptional design craft and deep AI fluency. You will report to Noam Segal, Director of AI Insights. You will build internal AI products that help Figmates understand our customers and their needs. These products will scale customer intimacy across Figma and inform product and business decisions. You enjoy figuring things out by making them. You own products from the first idea through design, building, evaluation, and adoption. You build primarily with AI tools and apply strong design and product judgment throughout. You ship early, improve rapidly, and hold internal experiences to the care expected of customer-facing Figma products. This is a full-time role that can be held from our New York City or San Francisco hub - or remotely in the United States. What you’ll do at Figma: Identify where Figmates need better customer understanding. Choose opportunities where an internal product can make a meaningful difference Design clear, compelling experiences that help employees find customer evidence, understand needs, and make informed decisions Use AI tools to build and ship internal products. Own the work from initial concept through launch and continued use Ship focused versions early. Improve them rapidly through feedback, actual use, and careful attention to interaction and visual details Define a high quality bar for AI behavior, evidence quality, and usability. Build evaluations that expose failures and verify improvements Partner with Research, Design, Product, Engineering, and internal users to launch products and support adoption Demonstrate what you build, explain your decisions, and share reusable tools and practices. Measure whether the products improve customer understanding We’d love to hear from you if you have: Demonstrated exceptional design craft through a background in UX or product design, with strong interaction design, visual judgment, and the ability to simplify complex workflows without sacrificing important details Build and shippped impactful products by turning ambitious ideas into working solutions using AI tools, demonstrating significant hands-on contributions, strong execution, and sustained value beyond initial prototypes Applied deep AI fluency to build sophisticated workflows that connect models, data, and tools, troubleshoot failures across prompts and integrations, and translate emerging capabilities into effective products Exercised strong product judgment by identifying unmet user needs, translating complex customer information into intuitive experiences, and making thoughtful tradeoffs across scope, quality, and speed While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have: Hold an academic background in design, interaction design, or human-computer interaction Bring a track record in customer research or in building research platforms and tools that help employees explore customer evidence Align teams around product priorities, communicate a clear point of view, and drive adoption by resolving competing needs with clear tradeoffs Build evaluations based on realistic tasks to verify the accuracy, evidence quality, and usability of AI-powered products Demonstrate familiarity with Figma’s products At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Pay Transparency Disclosure Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. Figma offers equity to employees, as well as a competitive package of additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement benefits with company contributions; parental leave and reproductive or family planning support; mental health and wellness benefits; and paid time off.
